title: Shakers — WordPress Developer project network

economics.evidence: Shakers states a six-month average project duration; individual WordPress project rates are visible only after matching.

required_materials: Production WordPress project examples with the applicant's specific contribution
AI certification interview when requested by the platform

reasons: Official current route dedicated to project-based WordPress developers
Remote project model and freelance contracting/payment workflow
Strong overlap with WordPress, PHP, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, WooCommerce, Elementor, Gutenberg, ACF, MySQL, Core Web Vitals and maintenance
Potential recurring work; Shakers states a six-month average project duration
material_gaps: No specific client WordPress assignment, deadline or guaranteed workload is publicly exposed
Selective certification process; the platform states only 4% of applicants enter its certified talent pool
AI-oriented assessment and senior production evidence must be represented truthfully
Individual project budget and availability appear only after profile matching

decision.reason: Current official project network and registration route are valid, but the authoritative route is the Shakers platform and no direct application email or public individual assignment is exposed.

next_action.reason: Create a truthful WordPress developer profile, document production work and performance/maintenance results, set availability and rate, and complete the platform assessment before viewing matched projects.
